author: Killswitch73
quote:
Bad bad bad bad. 

Game frame rates in 2026 capped at 30 frames per second. It goes down to around 15fps. 

Don’t get me wrong the game is nice to look at but that’s it. 

Poor mechanics, robotic, sluggish, input lag galore, glitches, bugs everywhere, the super poor finished product. Can’t steal cars (grand theft auto) no hookers. 

I wanted to escape the real world and get away with bad stuff in a game that we can’t do in real society. But this game is so woke. Cuck boyfriend simulator. 


Played 19 hours and I got bored after the first 7. Game is just boring boring and more boring. It’s not really free roam either.

RDR2 is My favourite ever game I’ve ever played and played and completed 4 times over 3 generations of GPU , 3080ti , 4090 and now 5090 4k oled goodness. Best game ever Red Dead Redemption 2. Even today some games just can’t keep up. 

But this GTA6 is nowhere near RDR2 level of story telling. 

Shame on you Rockstar.
